> Before opening a pull request, please read [How to Contribute](/CONTRIBUTING.md#how-to-contribute) — it explains how this project handles contributions.

## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Related issue

Closes #<issue-number> (if applicable).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Other (describe):

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The change builds and the tests pass locally (`bazel build //...` and `bazel test //...`).
- [ ] I have added or updated tests where it makes sense.
- [ ] I have updated documentation where relevant.

## Notes for reviewers

Anything you would like reviewers to focus on.
